newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL PARANAGUA/SANTOS SUGAR SHIPPING CONDITIONS.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar. PARANAGUA: Vessels: Amanpulo loading 27,500 tonnes sugar using big bags. Sea Duty II loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Waiting to dock, seven vessels to load bagged sugar and two to load bulk.
Road: 255 trucks carrying sugar arrived on Aug 7. Loading: 2,525 tonnes using big bags, 3,563 tonnes bulk.
NOTE: Loading resumed Thursday after rain hampered operations for most of the week. On Friday, skies were partly cloudy and the weather was cool and windy but dry.
Stocks: 23,960 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
